provenance.report: Heavy-Load Checker 1.0.0, run-20261110-235227, section 11 (language-runtime compute comparison)
provenance.file_count_note: 13 HLC reference files = 3 .matrix + 3 .php + 3 .py + 3 .js + 1 .rs (prime.rs). The 14th file, phase0_calibration.matrix, is NOT an HLC artifact; it is a Phase 0 harness fixture with role:calibration and is listed separately.
provenance.owner_attestation: These artifacts were produced by a Heavy-Load Checker run present in the repository owner's local environment (OneDrive Desktop) and are machine-generated benchmark fixtures, not third-party library code. No LICENSE, COPYING, NOTICE or SPDX header accompanies the external run. They are vendored as inert data: they are not under src/, are not part of any Cargo target, are not compiled into the crate or the wasm module, and are never linked into any binary. The repository license GPL-3.0-or-later applies to the repository. This is an OWNER ATTESTATION recorded for provenance, NOT independent authorship verification; it is recorded because A3 requires provenance/license status to be explicit. ON 2026-11-11 THE REPOSITORY OWNER REVIEWED AND CONFIRMED the GPL/provenance status of these fixtures for vendoring under the repository's GPL-3.0-or-later licence, clearing the commit gate recorded in README.md.
provenance.fallback_if_disclaimed: Delete the 13 vendored files and keep ONLY this manifest's external path + SHA-256 references; the harness then reads them from the recorded external run directory.
provenance.note: Byte-exact copies. Do NOT edit constants, loop bodies or checksum lines. The .matrix sources self-time with now_ms() and emit TIME_US in 1000-microsecond steps; that legacy field is recorded but NEVER used for Phase 0 deltas.

timing_option: A - harness-side external monotonic timing (time.perf_counter_ns); no language change, no stdlib surface, no sandbox decision, no new builtin, no docs/wasm churn

now_ms_impl.native: start.elapsed().as_millis() as i64 - truncating millisecond resolution

checksum_first.on_mismatch: reject the entire run; never publish a partial median
checksum_first.calibration_exclusion: role:calibration is excluded by an EXPLICIT literal allowlist only. There is NO general 'skip a missing RESULT line' branch.

checksum_semantics.prime: RESULT 5133 121013308 - count of primes below 50000 and their sum
checksum_semantics.json: RESULT 249868800 9163 - accumulated total and length of the last serialized row text
checksum_semantics.map: RESULT 44432313 100000 - accumulated lookup values followed by the STRING LITERAL " 100000" (with a leading space) at benchmarks/compare/map.matrix:21: println("RESULT " + string(acc) + " 100000");. It is NOT string(100000) and NOT a computed lookup count. Verified directly against the vendored source.
checksum_semantics.python_json: ABSENT - there is no json reference implementation in the HLC sources for Python; do not describe it as 'skipped' or 'traceback'. Geomeans vs Python therefore cover prime and map only.

prime.description: 50,000 trial divisions with one is_prime() call per iteration
prime.inline_case_transformation: verbatim minus exactly 3 lines (line numbers 8, 16, 18): let t0 = now_ms(); / let us = (now_ms() - t0) * 1000; / println("TIME_US " + string(us));. constants, loops and the RESULT expression unchanged.

json.correction: The plan's 'byte-identical 9,163-character JSON across all variants' claim is NOT verified and is NOT asserted here. 9163 is the length of the LAST serialized row text, not a cross-variant identifier.

map.description: 64 string keys x 100,000 map lookups with per-iteration key construction

calibration.registrations: none - never in BENCH_ITERS, BENCH_FLOORS, any benchmark run, any geomean, ratio, delta or floor
calibration.runtime_location: the harness copies this committed definition to a temp directory OUTSIDE the repo before execution
calibration.classification: explicit literal allowlist keyed by role:calibration; never a general skip-missing-RESULT branch

fixture_sets.note: The 3 deterministic RESULT-only sources live INLINE as raw Rust string literals inside tests/engine_matrix.rs const CASES. They are conformance fixtures ONLY, never timed.

variants.name: native
variants.reason: The locally available binary has no native backend ('the native backend is not enabled in this build'). AOT requires LLVM 18.1+ and a runtime compilation step that is not compute. Frozen from the external report instead; no AOT claim is made.

asserted_result_pins.aot: NOT asserted (aot:false on all 3 Case rows; native backend unavailable locally)

deviations.text: The >=10x workload-scaling suggestion is WITHDRAWN. External microsecond timing already gives compute >> 1 ms (117/221/33 ms), and scaling would change the pinned constants and therefore the checksum-verified RESULT lines, which section 2 non-goal #7 forbids. Constants stay pinned.

BENCH_ITERS / BENCH_FLOORS rows are NOT added in Phase 0. Literal A2 is a No-Go: benchmarks/map.matrix and benchmarks/json.matrix already exist as two of the 8 gated workloads, so the stems collide; adding new floors would make `bench --gate --compare --runs 5` gate 11 workloads on shared CI runners with no pinned-host calibration. src/cli.rs is untouched (zero diff) and the 8 gated workloads are exactly preserved. Floors are re-baselined in Phase 4 with a pinned host and recorded rationale. The new harness reports iters/sec itself, so rate reporting is preserved.

tools/gate.sh and tools/difftest.sh are NOT wired into the 3-OS CI matrix. gate.sh builds native+gui (LLVM 18 + webkit, absent on ubuntu/macos runners) and difftest.sh hardcodes target/debug/spid3r.exe with no cross-platform binary detection; both would turn CI red. Both are run locally TWICE in the DoD gate sequence. A new additive ubuntu-only `phase0` CI job runs the blocking manifest/fixture verifiers and self-test instead.

The 3 HLC fixtures join the differential set via ADDITIVE golden-value Case rows in tests/engine_matrix.rs (exact expected stdout, exit code, stderr) and a NEW read-only verifier, with NO edits to any existing gate and NO stdout normalization inside an existing gate. No scoped contract deviation is required.
